scope: Independent source review of root P04-18 Window/worker/desktop wiring, immutable DTO admission and new integration tests; excludes own parser/reader implementation
checks: Saved totals and History retain independent pending requests and counters, sharing exactly one active optional StatisticsRequest record; new dates coalesce only History pending work.
Dispatch is deferred, single-shot and gated by busy/closing/other active optional work; active record is installed before direct request signal.
The saved reply gate rejects history-kind active work; History replies require kind/session/request/date, then still bind the currently live Page/session before application.
Returned/stale same-date requests cannot replace later request IDs; Page validates selected date/current loading token. A prior closed Page cannot receive a replacement Page result.
Busyfalse without a result fails only the active request kind/date and then schedules independent pending work; failure or cancellation cannot fabricate missing/empty history.
Closing an auxiliary Page discards its pending requests without cancelling an unrelated command; window close discards pending work and retains existing deferred-close/cancel behavior.
A newer profile session clears both pending kinds/current owner slot and immediately resets History Page facts; old session replies are rejected.
Bridge preflight accepts only a published nonzero session/request and valid Gregorian date; actual read occurs on existing worker with its already held lease and no library query/recovery.
Worker builds an owned primitive snapshot and tagged immutable packet, propagating Missing versus Failed. Cancelled errors take existing cancellation handling.
Stop/session are rechecked inside QObject-bound queued delivery; busy stays true through historyReady, direct reentry is rejected and QPointer guards later member access after deletion.
New read failures use dispatch recoverLibrarySnapshot=false; no library revision, profile save, engine sampling, second thread or lease acquisition is introduced.
Actual desktop connections and Qt metatype registrations bind the exact HistoryDate/HistoryPresentation types.
Only literal intended root recipe deltas separate five production files from prior qualified source hashes; selected recipe AST literals were read as data, never executed.
Actual generated files are read through Bridge/held worker; known44/55 bytes, observed0 and unknown hours, date navigation and explicit refresh are asserted.
Window/model/filter/width and initial library snapshot count are preserved; primitive immutable old snapshot survives explicit fixture edit and reread.
Missing/version/symlink cases require independent states and no library revision; pure native parse/helper values are used rather than a duplicated expected parser.
Synthetic admission cases distinguish request kind despite equal numeric IDs, pending date coalescing, Page destruction/reopen, profile reset and old session/date rejection.
Immediate cancellation is connected after real Bridge request dispatch, so the stop is requested before GUI queued-result processing even if the worker has already queued it.
Dispatch-slot deletion destroys Window only after its new QTimer request fires; QPointer guard checks prevent subsequent Window access.
Stack Bridge lifetime precedes Window and generated Profile cleanup on every early assertion return; no raw unowned Bridge leaks are introduced.
No sleeps/engine/public network/profile input is used; qWaitFor/QTRY conditions retain bounded existing deadlines.
scope_limits: Profile intact() verifies supplied bytes/device/inode and absence of day backup/saving; it does not establish no read-atime change or complete directory immutability.
No actual live history writer, source manager, persistent global owner or full rolling-history parity is tested.

New dedicated Bridge deletion-from-historyReady and latest-pending no-packet tests are not separately present; current guarded delivery/common failure paths are source-reviewed without inventing test credit.
